title: Payment Terms Table — Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
Payment terms of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** differ by activity type in whether an installment plan is offered, how many monthly installments it has and the smallest fee total that qualifies; the due period, the accepted payment methods and the credit balance refund period are the same for every type.

| Activity type | Days after posting within which a fee is settled (posting date is day 0) | Installment plan offered | Monthly installments in the plan | Smallest fee total on the participation for which the plan is offered | Days after the participation closes within which a credit balance is refunded |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Campus Club Membership | 14 | no | 1 | 0.00 | 30 |
| UIL Academic and Robotics Team | 14 | no | 1 | 0.00 | 30 |
| Middle School UIL Athletics | 14 | no | 1 | 0.00 | 30 |
| Fine Arts Performing Ensemble | 14 | yes | 3 | 150.00 | 30 |
| High School UIL Athletics | 14 | no | 1 | 0.00 | 30 |
| Cheer and Dance Team | 14 | yes | 3 | 150.00 | 30 |
| Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip | 14 | yes | 3 | 150.00 | 30 |

**Accepted payment methods (every type):** online card payment, ACH bank draft, personal check and money order.

The number of installments is 1 where the type offers no plan, and the threshold shown as 0.00 for those types has no plan attached to it. Days are calendar days.

## Points of reading

- The fee due period counts from the posting date as day 0: a fee posted on a hypothetical Monday the 2nd is settled within the period through the 16th, 14 calendar days later.
- Where a plan is offered, the threshold compares with the fee total on the participation: a hypothetical fee total of 149.99 on a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation is below the 150.00 threshold, and one of 150.00 meets it.
